title: Family and BJP workers protest after boy's death in roadshow

tea.why: Family members and BJP workers protested following the death of a 13-year-old boy struck by an excavator during a political roadshow.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded action against the excavator driver and event organizers, alongside the construction of a speed breaker near Jharkhandi Gate.
tea.changed: Nov 18: Protesters blocked the Gorakhpur-Deoria road before calling off the demonstration after receiving administrative assurances.

summary: Following the death of a teenager who was allegedly struck by an excavator during a political roadshow in Gorakhpur, family members and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) workers gathered to protest. The incident occurred on Wednesday as Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav held a roadshow in the city. The victim's family and BJP supporters accused authorities of delaying action and subsequently blocked the Gorakhpur-Deoria road at the Jharkhandi crossing around 6 pm. The blockade caused a traffic jam spanning approximately three kilometres on both sides of the road. District Magistrate Deepak Meena, Senior Superintendent of Police Kaustubh, and SP City Nimish Patil arrived at the location to engage with the demonstrators. According to police, the protest concluded around 8 pm after the administration assured the family that their demands would be addressed.
demands: Take action against the JCB driver
Take action against the roadshow organizers
Construct a speed breaker near Jharkhandi Gate
response: District Magistrate Deepak Meena, Senior Superintendent of Police Kaustubh, and SP City Nimish Patil reached the site and assured the family that their demands would be addressed, according to police sources. An FIR was subsequently registered at the AIIMS police station.

deaths.text: A 13-year-old boy was killed after allegedly being run over by an excavator.

updates.text: Family and BJP workers blocked the Gorakhpur-Deoria road demanding action over the boy's death.
Police and district officials arrived at the protest site and the demonstration ended after administrative assurances.
